measurementFrame: Live Great Britain regional electricity-system context, not AI-attributed energy consumption.
summary: The visualization fetches the current regional forecast interval from the NESO Carbon Intensity API for Great Britain and maps each distribution-network region onto the globe.

carbonIntensity.label: Carbon intensity
carbonIntensity.provenance: Current regional forecast carbon intensity from the NESO Carbon Intensity API.

renewablePercentage.label: Renewables share
renewablePercentage.provenance: Calculated from the live generation mix as biomass, hydro, solar, and wind.

lowCarbonPercentage.label: Low-carbon share
lowCarbonPercentage.provenance: Calculated from the live generation mix as biomass, hydro, nuclear, solar, and wind.

gasPercentage.label: Gas share
gasPercentage.provenance: Current regional gas share from the NESO generation mix.

limitations: This live feed covers Great Britain electricity-system regions only.
Values describe regional grid context, not AI-attributed energy use or emissions.
The feed is near-real-time forecast and estimated grid data for the current settlement interval.
Regional coordinates are approximate visual anchors for distribution-network areas, not exact boundaries.
